policy.alts: 20% of original at 4x/8x/16x/32x; after 2x a trail sells 25% per hit 40% below the running peak; 20% core; never below cost+15%
policy.btc: no base trail; armed (Pi-cycle/Mayer/weekly RSI, or the manual arm file) -> one-shot exit 15% below peak to the core
policy.ladder: old rule: sell 15% at +15% over cost, +8pp per +8%, until 20% nominal core
